The signed-moment index measures a genuine collision obstruction beyond Jordan-size counting, and all-s Jacobi extremals show the upper degree bound cannot be reduced. It is a complete class invariant for finite real-spectrum inputs, not a routine Hermite substitution or arbitrary numerical slice.
